title: Crop Insurance Crop-Year Calendar of Dates
content:
March 15, July 15, August 15 and December 10 are the dates that frame a Crop Insurance crop year. Every plan and coverage level keeps the same calendar.

| Plan and coverage level | Sales closing | Coverage change deadline | Cancellation | Written agreement request | Acreage reporting | Premium billing | End of insurance period | Continuous policy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Catastrophic Risk Protection (CAT) | March 15 | March 15 | March 15 | March 15 | July 15 | August 15 | December 10 | Yes |
| Revenue Protection 65% Coverage | March 15 | March 15 | March 15 | March 15 | July 15 | August 15 | December 10 | Yes |
| Revenue Protection 70% Coverage | March 15 | March 15 | March 15 | March 15 | July 15 | August 15 | December 10 | Yes |
| Revenue Protection 75% Coverage | March 15 | March 15 | March 15 | March 15 | July 15 | August 15 | December 10 | Yes |
| Revenue Protection 80% Coverage | March 15 | March 15 | March 15 | March 15 | July 15 | August 15 | December 10 | Yes |
| Revenue Protection 85% Coverage | March 15 | March 15 | March 15 | March 15 | July 15 | August 15 | December 10 | Yes |

**Treatment of a late acreage report**, at every level from Catastrophic Risk Protection (CAT) to Revenue Protection 85% Coverage: provider may determine acreage; coverage may be reduced to zero.

## What each date is

- **Sales closing** — Month-day by which an application or a change of coverage must be signed (spring crops; winter wheat uses its own fall date).
- **Coverage change deadline** — Month-day by which coverage level or plan may be changed for the coming crop year.
- **Cancellation** — Month-day by which a written cancellation must be received to stop coverage for the next crop year.
- **Written agreement request** — Month-day by which a written agreement request must be filed.
- **Acreage reporting** — Month-day by which planted acres must be reported.
- **Premium billing** — Month-day on which premium and fees are billed.
- **End of insurance period** — Month-day the insurance period ends for spring crops.
- **Continuous policy** — whether the policy renews each year unless cancelled by the cancellation date.
- **Late acreage report** — Treatment of a late acreage report.

## The year in order

Read in calendar order, a crop year at any level runs: March 15, the sales closing date, which is also the coverage change deadline, the cancellation date and the written agreement deadline; July 15, the acreage reporting date; August 15, the premium billing date; December 10, the end of the insurance period for spring crops. Because every level is a continuous policy, the same calendar recurs each crop year for a policy that is not cancelled by the cancellation date.
